page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.16xlarge is a storage-focused instance designed for I/O-intensive and data-heavy applications. Powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor built on x86_64 architecture, this virtual machine provides 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores via hyperthreading, alongside 33 MB of Level 3 cache. Memory capacity stands at 256 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 4 GB per vCPU allocation. Local persistent capacity is provided by 7,679 GB of bundled SSD storage, accompanied by a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile managed under the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results reveal substantial parallel throughput contrasted against modest single-core execution speed. Single-threaded metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, place in the lower quartile, mirrored by single-threaded gzip compression at 18.97 GB/sec. When all 64 threads are engaged, performance scales into median industry tiers, producing a multi-core Geekbench score of 9,986.0 and an extended PassMark CPU rating of 38,203.37. Multi-threaded decompression performance is notable, registering in the upper quartile at 199.24 GB/sec on bzip3 workloads. Memory bandwidth sustains 118.82 GB/sec for uncached block reads and 47.43 GB/sec for sequential writes.

From an operational tradeoff perspective, the instance leverages its significant multi-core density and large local solid-state storage pool to offer resource efficiency for storage-heavy workloads without requiring external block attach overhead. Text processing and single-stream execution demonstrate limitations, and the absence of hardware accelerators restricts generative machine learning throughput. Consequently, the configuration is best aligned with transactional databases, distributed storage clusters, in-memory caching systems such as Redis, batch decompression jobs, and large-scale data ingestion pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2g.16xlarge is a storage-focused instance featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs and 32 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz on x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 256 GB of system RAM, it integrates 7,679 GB of high-capacity local SSD storage and a 10 Gbps baseline network connection. Benchmark profiles reveal moderate single-thread compute capabilities, offset by robust multi-threaded processing power and high multi-core decompression bandwidth reaching 199.24 GB/sec. With 43.96 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and solid uncached memory throughput, the server avoids network-attached storage latency for heavy data pipelines. The configuration provides balanced memory-to-core density alongside massive local disk volume, making it well matched for transactional database systems, distributed file stores, caching layers, and high-throughput data processing workloads.
